issues.explanation: No routes file appears in change.diff, so a route-level guard for entity.members is not evidenced; the 403 relies on Members::mount alone.
memberRole is validated with an inline rules array in saveRole instead of the project pattern #[Validate] plus $this->validate().
selectedMembershipId is a client-writable public ID without #[Locked]; cross-entity swaps are blocked by entity-scoped lookups plus authorization, so impact is limited.
confirmRemoval, cancelRemoval, closeMember and render perform no server-side authorization check; they only flip UI state or re-render, so impact is limited.
Employee coverage asserts mount/route forbidden but never calls sendInvite, cancelInvite, saveRole or removeMember directly as an unauthorized user, which the Livewire policy requires per action.

conventions.evidence: Follows #[Validate] on inviteEmail/inviteRole (Members.php:59-63), policies manageMembers/assignRole (Members.php:77,85,179,200), reversible migration (2026_10_29_120000_create_entity_invites_table.php:66-92), #[Fillable] (EntityInvite.php:509), Bulma modal/x-input/x-mail::message, docs+CHANGELOG updates; deviations: inline memberRole rules, unlocked selectedMembershipId.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole/confirmRemoval/cancelRemoval/removeMember), clear names (normalizeEmail, scopePending, managerCount, inviteRateKey), consistent with sibling Members component, no dead code.

requirements.evidence: Implements invites table+unique (migration:668-682), normalizeEmail (EntityInvite.php:536-546), EXPIRY_DAYS=7 + scopePending (517,561-564), sendInvite checks+rate limit+queue+audit+reset (Members.php:82-157), cancelInvite scoping (159-164), PendingInvites accept/decline/session/redirect (PendingInvites.php:324-386), switcher/onboarding <hr> gating (pending-invites.blade.php:1073-1076), mail markdown + pt_BR strings, modal header ui.members_details (members.blade.php:1008), no wire:confirm; gap: no routes/*.php change in diff file list for entity.members route layer.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves invites/manager-only members/modal/mail/lang/docs/tests; Settings cascade (Settings.php:428) and nav gating (default-page.blade.php:859, dashboard.blade.php:883) are directly adjacent; no unrelated features.

security.evidence: Server-side authorize on mount/sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole (Members.php:77,85,161,179,200) and invitee-only 403 via invitation() (PendingInvites.php:403-410), entity-scoped findOrFail, strict validation, {{ }} escaping, Fillable allowlist, RateLimiter 10/hour (Members.php:116-142); gaps: UI-state actions/render lack authorize, selectedMembershipId unlocked.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses scopePending/scopeForEmail/normalizeEmail, UserRole enum casts, existing policies, x-input and mail theme; helpers managerCount/inviteRateKey/selectedMembership avoid duplication; no new service layers or speculative abstractions.

tests.evidence: Ships EntityInviteMailTest (2), EntityInviteModelTest (8), InvitesTest (10: quota, race->inviteEmail, expired-replace, normalization), MembersTest (mount 403, openMember 404, owner-immutable, last-manager 403, cancelInvite scoping), PendingInvitesTest (11: hr gating, idempotent accept, expired->invite, stranger 403); missing direct employee-action calls for each Members action.

review.summary: The change implements invite-only membership end to end (model, factory, migration, mail, both Livewire components, views, translations, docs and broad Pest coverage) with sound authorization scoping and rate limiting. Gaps are defense-in-depth nits: no evidenced route-layer guard, inline memberRole validation, an unlocked selection ID, unauthenticated UI-state actions, and missing per-action unauthorized tests, so it is approvable with nits.
